question: Under what condition must concealment be carried out in the mortal world among the lowest of men?
premises: Concealment is something that must be done.
Effort is the means for such concealment.
This duty applies in the mortal world among the lowest of men.
inference: Concealment requires deliberate effort in the setting of the mortal world among the lowest of men.
plain_english: What is to be concealed must be concealed with effort in the mortal world, among the lowest of men.
